summary.text: Brian Reynolds is the non-voting Tribal Representative of the Houlton Band of Maliseet Indians in the Maine House of Representatives and lives in Augusta. The House profile lists membership on the Inland Fisheries and Wildlife Committee.

paragraphs.text: The profile lists House service in the 132nd Legislature.
It gives tribal administrator as the occupation and a B.S. in secondary social studies education (1994).
Listed affiliations include the Maine Indian Tribal State Commission, the Tribal Council, Houlton High School football coaching and bow hunting.
It lists a partner, Margaret, and three children.
